description: This Java class implements a Kafka consumer statistics service for monitoring Kafka consumer group lag and offsets, with scheduled logging and group registration management.

classes.name: GroupTopicStats
classes.description: A data class representing Kafka topic partition lag statistics with custom string representation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the consumer stats service, sets up scheduled logging if enabled.

methods.name: startLogScheduling
methods.description: Starts scheduled task to log Kafka consumer group lag statistics periodically.

methods.name: isStatsPrintRequired
methods.description: Checks if info level logging is enabled to determine if stats should be printed.

methods.name: getTopicsStatsWithLag
methods.description: Calculates and returns list of topic partition lag statistics.

methods.name: registerClientGroup
methods.description: Adds a consumer group ID to monitored groups if stats are enabled.

methods.name: unregisterClientGroup
methods.description: Removes a consumer group ID from monitored groups if stats are enabled.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Shuts down scheduled executor and closes Kafka consumer on bean destruction.
